levels.name: Self-care
levels.what: TRIX suggests a fix and re-checks later.

levels.name: Crew medical officer
levels.what: Medical officer reviews within the day; may run an exam or procedure.

levels.name: Flight surgeon
levels.what: Added to the Earth report with priority. Live consult only if the link delay allows.

levels.name: Flight surgeon (private)
levels.what: Private channel; content is not shared with the crew.

levels.name: Emergency
levels.what: Triage agents start immediately and a crewmate is guided through the procedure. Never waits for Earth.

rules: A red absolute limit always wins over personal baselines.
Two different indicators amber on the same day for the same body part escalate one level.
Persistent amber (see each indicator's escalation keys) escalates one level.
Emergency never waits for Earth. At Mars, flight-surgeon items are queued for the next link window; at ISS or Moon they may be consulted live.
Confidence below 0.5 (too little data) caps the level at self_care and asks for a re-measurement.
